title: Godot 4.6 crashes on Wayland compositor with "Embed Game on Next Play" active
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.6 only, because Embedded Play on Wayland is introduced here

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable unknown - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sun, 11 Jan 2026 17:10:53 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (nvidia) - AMD Ryzen 9 7950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 62.46 GiB memory

### Issue description

I tested without the embedding feature, so far it seems stable, but the ``ERROR: Condition "err != VK_SUCCESS" is true. Returning: ERR_CANT_CREATE`` is still appearing.

### Steps to reproduce

- I`m using the [niri window manager](https://github.com/YaLTeR/niri) on Arch linux.
- Enable **Embed Game on Next Play**
- press F5 for playing
- running around ingame

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Currently my project is too big for a MRP, I could create one if necessary.
